key_insight: An autonomous LLM-driven agent can iteratively design quantum circuits under constraints by combining web knowledge, critique, code generation, and experimental feedback in a closed loop.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical blueprint for automating quantum feature-map and ansatz design, reducing reliance on specialist human circuit engineering.
method: Seven-component agent loop: Exploration, Generation, Discussion, Validation, Storage, Evaluation, Review.
Uses literature-grounded critique plus executable code generation to refine circuit candidates.
Targets two design tasks: quantum feature maps for classification and ansatzes for VQE chemistry.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on image classification benchmarks and seven molecular ground-state estimation tasks, where the best generated circuits matched or exceeded representative baselines and scaled favorably in larger-qubit settings.
watch_item: Performance may depend on access to reliable literature, evaluation code, and well-defined constraints, so robustness and generalization outside the tested tasks remain uncertain.
paper_title: An LLM System for Autonomous Variational Quantum Circuit Design
